items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Jacareí (SP) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1; proposals close Nov 24, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
